title: adoptSessions queues a tail-read check for every session on each snapshot (O(n^2) lookups, redundant with the visible-repair pass)
outcome: adoptSessions queues a tail-read check for every session on each snapshot (O(n^2) lookups, redundant with the visible-repair pass)
acceptance: A deterministic regression on a large resident session collection demonstrates that checking repair demand for invisible sessions performs no resident-session search, while visible demand and a previously invisible session becoming visible preserve existing repair eligibility.

The narrow change removes the all-session-by-all-session search from the existing repair-demand path without changing visible recovery, retry scheduling, or retained repair state; no new registry, cache, or broader refactor is introduced. Focused existing and new regressions pass on the exact candidate.

A matched before/after measurement records the same repair-demand scenario and its actual result and limitations; independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the exact final full gate passes before landing through the integration owner.
